title: Al-Qiyamah: meaning and reflection: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Qiyamah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 36. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: Loving the immediate; two kinds of faces
Purpose and proof of the Resurrection

panels.title: Tadabbur
points: What does He want me to do?

arabic.text: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى (٣٦) أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ (٣٧) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ (٣٨) فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ (٣٩) أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ (٤٠)

questions.q: In the portal response box, write one sentence on what 75:20 to 21 ask of you. Start: 'These ayat warn me ...'
questions.a: For example: 'These ayat warn me not to choose quick pleasures over the Hereafter.'

questions.q: Reflection (Forms long answer): explain how Al-Qiyamah proves the Resurrection, using two ayat as evidence. Start: 'Al-Qiyamah proves ...' Today's rota group finishes any outstanding recitals.
questions.a: A paragraph with two cited ayat (for example 75:4 and 75:40) and a clear explanation.

questions.q: Extend: link 75:16 to 19 to the way we learn hifdh.
questions.a: Listening first (talaqqi), then following, then explanation: as Allah taught the Prophet ﷺ.

questions.q: How do 75:37 to 40 answer the doubt in 75:3?
options: The One who created us in stages can recreate us
questions.a: A) The One who created us in stages can recreate us. 75:40: 'Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?'

questions.q: Think again: If you had to explain Al-Qiyamah to a friend in one sentence, what would you say?
questions.a: The Resurrection is certain: the One who created us from a small beginning will bring us back, so live with purpose.
